faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in June?
faq.a: June in Marbella is warm and dry. Average air temperatures range from 24°C to 30°C, with sea temperatures between 20°C and 23°C. You'll get around 11 hours of sunshine daily, and rainfall is rare – typically under 10 mm for the whole month. It's the perfect window for boat chartering before the intense July heat.

faq.q: Is the sea calm enough for boating in June?
faq.a: Yes, generally. The Mediterranean is calm in June, with prevailing winds from the east at 10–15 knots. Mornings are usually glassy, with a light sea breeze building in the afternoon. Swell heights average 0.5–1 metre, comfortable for all our boats, from the 8m Dubhe to the 29m Ferretti 94.

faq.q: What is the best time of day to charter a boat in June?
faq.a: The best time is between 10:00 and 16:00, when the sea is calmest and the sun is high. For a more relaxed vibe, consider a late-afternoon charter from 16:00 to 20:00 – you'll still get warm weather and a spectacular sunset. Evening charters are also popular, with temperatures around 22°C.

faq.q: Which boats are best for June weather?
faq.a: For small groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are perfect for a quick swim stop. For larger parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749/2h is a great value. If you want luxury, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski – ideal for June waters.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance for June?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. June marks the start of peak season in Marbella. Popular boats like the Azimut 39 and Pershing 46 are often booked weeks ahead. We recommend reserving at least 2–3 weeks in advance, especially for weekends. You can check availability via WhatsApp for any boat.

faq.q: What should I wear for a June boat trip?
faq.a: Light clothing, swimwear, a hat, and sunglasses are essential. Even though it's warm, bring a light jacket or windbreaker for the afternoon breeze. Sunscreen with SPF 30+ is a must – the UV index in June is high. Non-slip shoes are recommended for deck safety.

faq.q: Are there any weather risks in June?
faq.a: June is generally stable, but occasional afternoon thunderstorms can occur, especially if the wind shifts to the west (poniente). Our skipper monitors forecasts closely and will adjust the route or timing if needed. If a charter is cancelled due to unsafe weather, you'll receive a full refund.

data.body_html:
June is arguably the best month for a marbella boat rental june weather experience. With sea temperatures hitting 20–23°C, air temperatures of 24–30°C, and over 11 hours of daily sunshine, the conditions are ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and cruising the Costa del Sol. Whether you're planning a family day out or a luxury yacht party, this guide breaks down exactly what to expect and which boats to choose from our fleet at Puerto Banús.

Why June is the Sweet Spot for Chartering in Marbella

June sits between the mild spring and the scorching summer. You get the benefits of both: warm enough to enjoy the sea, but not yet the intense 35°C heat of July and August. The water is already swimmable – typically 20°C at the start of the month, rising to 23°C by the end. That's perfect for jumping off the back of a boat rental in Marbella without a wetsuit.

Rain is almost non-existent. The average for June is just 5–10 mm, usually falling as a brief evening shower that clears quickly. You'll have 90%+ chance of sunny skies on any given day, making it easy to plan your charter with confidence.

Sea Conditions: Calm Waters, Gentle Breezes

The Mediterranean off Marbella is famously calm in June. Prevailing winds come from the east (levante) at 10–15 knots, creating a light chop of 0.5–1 metre – comfortable for all our boats. Mornings are often glassy, ideal for a smooth ride out to Cabopino or Estepona.

In the afternoon, a thermal sea breeze picks up, but it rarely exceeds 15 knots. This actually helps with sailing and keeps you cool on deck. If you're sensitive to motion, we recommend a morning departure – the sea is at its flattest between 10:00 and 12:00.

Temperature Guide: Air and Water

  • Air temp: 24–30°C (average high 28°C)
  • Sea temp: 20–23°C, rising through the month
  • Sunshine: 11+ hours per day
  • UV index: High (7–9), so sunscreen is essential
  • Water clarity: Excellent, visibility up to 20m

Evenings are mild, around 22°C, so a sunset cruise is still comfortable with a light jacket. The sea stays warm well into the evening, making a late swim before dinner a real treat.

Best Boats for June Conditions

With calm seas and warm weather, you have the full fleet to choose from. For a budget-friendly option that still delivers, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749 for 2 hours is a favourite. It's fast, stable, and perfect for a family trip to Cala del Faro.

If you want to make a splash, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski – June's warm water makes it ideal for water sports. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers supreme luxury, while the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) is a great mid-range choice. All depart from Puerto Banús, just 20 minutes from Marbella centre.

Where to Go: June Itineraries

With 11 hours of daylight, you can cover a lot. A classic 4-hour trip heads west to Cala Cortés or Estepona, with a swim stop at a quiet cove. For a longer day (8 hours), push to Sotogrande or east to Cabo de Gata – though the latter is a bit far for a day trip.

In June, the sea is calm enough to anchor near Marbella Marina and enjoy lunch on deck. You'll often spot dolphins around the Río Verde estuary – a highlight for kids and adults alike. Always ask your skipper for the day's best route based on wind and currents.

Booking Tips for June

June is the start of peak season, so early booking is essential. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, with skipper, drinks, and VAT included. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski.

All other boats are quoted on request via WhatsApp – we'll respond within minutes. To secure your preferred date, especially weekends, we recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks ahead. Last-minute availability is possible but limited.

What's Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper and fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden costs

You won't need to bring anything except your swimsuit and sunscreen. The skipper handles navigation, safety, and can recommend the best anchorages based on the day's conditions.

June Weather FAQs

What is the weather like in Marbella in June?

June in Marbella is warm and dry. Average air temperatures range from 24°C to 30°C, with sea temperatures between 20°C and 23°C. You'll get around 11 hours of sunshine daily, and rainfall is rare – typically under 10 mm for the whole month. It's the perfect window for boat chartering before the intense July heat.

Is the sea calm enough for boating in June?

Yes, generally. The Mediterranean is calm in June, with prevailing winds from the east at 10–15 knots. Mornings are usually glassy, with a light sea breeze building in the afternoon. Swell heights average 0.5–1 metre, comfortable for all our boats, from the 8m Dubhe to the 29m Ferretti 94.

What is the best time of day to charter a boat in June?

The best time is between 10:00 and 16:00, when the sea is calmest and the sun is high. For a more relaxed vibe, consider a late-afternoon charter from 16:00 to 20:00 – you'll still get warm weather and a spectacular sunset. Evening charters are also popular, with temperatures around 22°C.

Which boats are best for June weather?

For small groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are perfect for a quick swim stop. For larger parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749/2h is a great value. If you want luxury, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski – ideal for June waters.

Do I need to book in advance for June?

Yes, absolutely. June marks the start of peak season in Marbella. Popular boats like the Azimut 39 and Pershing 46 are often booked weeks ahead. We recommend reserving at least 2–3 weeks in advance, especially for weekends. You can check availability via WhatsApp for any boat.

What should I wear for a June boat trip?

Light clothing, swimwear, a hat, and sunglasses are essential. Even though it's warm, bring a light jacket or windbreaker for the afternoon breeze. Sunscreen with SPF 30+ is a must – the UV index in June is high. Non-slip shoes are recommended for deck safety.

Are there any weather risks in June?

June is generally stable, but occasional afternoon thunderstorms can occur, especially if the wind shifts to the west (poniente). Our skipper monitors forecasts closely and will adjust the route or timing if needed. If a charter is cancelled due to unsafe weather, you'll receive a full refund.

Ready to Book Your June Charter?

With ideal weather, calm seas, and a fleet ready to go, June is the perfect time to experience Marbella from the water. Check out our full fleet and pricing to find your ideal boat. For any questions or to reserve, message us on WhatsApp – we're happy to help you plan the perfect day.
